verdict.rationale: The models docs offer versioned model IDs, `jev-latest`/`jev-preview` aliases, and explicit advice to pin a version and "move to the new one on your own schedule." The response reports which version answered, and `GET /v1/models` lists release dates. That is lifecycle hygiene, but no evidence describes what happens when a pinned version is retired. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/retirement policy, advance-notice periods or sunset timelines, deprecation notifications, version-to-version migration guides, and independent corroboration.
